sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entry_points (method_id TEXT, reason TEXT)
INSERT INTO entry_points (method_id, reason) SELECT method_id, 'http route' FROM symbols WHERE display LIKE 'Api.%' AND method_id IS NOT NULL AND display <> 'Api.Api'
INSERT INTO entry_points (method_id, reason) SELECT method_id, 'test' FROM symbols WHERE display LIKE 'ApiTest.%' AND method_id IS NOT NULL AND display <> 'ApiTest.ApiTest'
